answer: Split the epoch challenge into two halves: a commit at epoch open, a second word-triple revealed only mid-epoch. Each identitys final answer must fuse both halves coherently, with the prefix hash locked before the suffix words exist. A sybil farmers batch pipeline — one answer cloned across a hollow fleet — breaks: nothing can be precomputed, and each puppet needs genuine per-moment composition to reach its marble-smooth fusion of the two halves. Batch cloning dies at the zenith of the epoch instead of profiting.
